cognitive_contract.label: Model / stochastic & dynamic structural systems (National/International Olympiad)
cognitive_contract.decisive_act: Abstracting dynamic, physical, stochastic, or game-theoretic processes into formal mathematical structures and solving for protected quantity W.
cognitive_contract.band_protected_work: Require learner to set up difference boundary systems, bitwise XOR kernels, or rotational metric invariants without intermediate scaffolding.
cognitive_contract.support_posture: Activate the modeling framework or coordinate setup without establishing the decisive invariant equations.

slots.X: modeling an automated trading bot random walk as a second-order linear difference equation with absorbing barriers to evaluate win probability
slots.Y: trader starting with $2, win probability 2/3, loss probability 1/3, target $4 before $0
slots.Z: governing difference equation P_k = p*P_{k+1} + q*P_{k-1} with P_0 = 0 and P_N = 1, giving P_k = (1 - (q/p)^k) / (1 - (q/p)^N)
slots.wrong_idea: assuming symmetric random walk probability 2/4 = 1/2 or simple linear expectation without solving the characteristic polynomial of the Markov chain
slots.replacement_rule: asymmetric random walk has ratio q/p = (1/3)/(2/3) = 1/2, yielding P_2 = (1 - 1/4)/(1 - 1/16) = (3/4)/(15/16) = 4/5
slots.visual_job: render discrete Markov chain state-transition diagram showing states 0, 1, 2, 3, 4 with transition arrows labeled 2/3 and 1/3; avoid unmounted SVGs
slots.check_job: independent verification: solve the 3x3 tridiagonal linear system for [P_1, P_2, P_3]^T: P_1 = 2/3 P_2, P_2 = 2/3 P_3 + 1/3 P_1, P_3 = 2/3(1) + 1/3 P_2. Solves to P_1 = 2/5, P_2 = 4/5, P_3 = 14/15. Verified.

core2_custody.stem_requirement: Exact formulation of an international Olympiad mathematical modeling demand
core2_custody.hint_ladder_requirement: H1 activates the stochastic/difference framing; H2 provides intermediate characteristic recurrence; preserves W
core2_custody.solution_requirement: Locked pre-commit; complete formal derivation detailing the mathematical model
core2_custody.distractor_requirement: Every distractor explained with specific student modeling errors or naive linear simplifications

core1a_declarative.anti_leak_rule: Strict prohibition on leaking Core 2 exact parameters or textual answer in Core 1A text

core1b_reconstruction.model_alternation: Reconstruction must use an alternative analytical pathway (e.g. tridiagonal matrix inversion or martingale stopping theorem)

core2a_supported_practice.transfer_obligation: Near-transfer item modeling a related random walk or absorbing Markov chain

core2b_transfer_assessment.transfer_obligation: Far-transfer item applying the modeling technique to an Olympiad problem
